name: aggregated_ouro_PD_rate0_128
timing_scope: Finite arrival-to-drain observation. Not established sustainable capacity.
NVML_scope: Utilization mean covers the arrival window. Sampled peak HBM covers arrival through drain. Not SM occupancy or exclusive kernel busy.
host_CPU_counter_scope: Stage-level host wall spans and whole-process CPU during those spans. Includes warm-up and background threads. Not exclusive request phases or GPU kernel time.
D_refusal_scope: Binding refusal: D blocks while P has a slot and KV credit. Raw simultaneous P/D refusals are reported separately.
P_queue_scope: Admitted P wait plus P-slot backlog. Simultaneous D refusals remain explicit. D-only reservation waiting is excluded. P kernel saturation and matched P service are mandatory.
